questions.question: What does the executive order signed by President Trump on October 22, 2026 direct FHFA to do about mortgage insurance?
questions.reference: The order directs FHFA to create a pilot program to proactively cancel mortgage insurance premiums for borrowers who meet equity requirements.

questions.question: Which agencies are directed to reduce interest rates on their single-family home loans under the Trump housing executive order?
questions.reference: The secretaries of USDA and VA are directed to reduce interest rates on single-family home loans made by their departments.

questions.question: What does the Trump housing executive order establish for manufactured housing?
questions.reference: The order establishes a task force for improving the quality and lowering the cost of manufactured housing.

questions.question: According to KBW analysts, why might the executive order's title insurance expansion have limited impact on title insurers?
questions.reference: KBW analysts noted that refinances account for only around 7% of title premiums, so the impact may be limited if the program covers only refinances.

questions.question: What level did the 10-year Treasury yield fall to, according to Logan Mohtashami?
questions.reference: The 10-year Treasury yield fell to 4.97% at the time of writing.

questions.question: Which key yield level did the 10-year Treasury fail to sustain a move above, according to Logan Mohtashami?
questions.reference: The 10-year yield failed to sustain a move above 5.35%, triggering a technical reversal.

questions.question: What mortgage rate level does Logan Mohtashami want rates to get back under?
questions.reference: Mohtashami wants mortgage rates to get back under 6.64%, which requires the 10-year yield to move lower.

questions.question: Why does Logan Mohtashami say the 10-year yield moved higher toward 5.35% this month?
questions.reference: He says the Federal Reserve has said many times that the AI boom is inflationary and gives a boost to the economy, which pushed the 10-year yield higher toward 5.35%.

questions.question: Which law's ban on institutional investors buying single-family homes is Treasury's proposal carving exemptions from?
questions.reference: The exemptions are carved out of the ban in the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act.

questions.question: How long do institutional investors have to buy newly built build-to-rent communities under Treasury's proposal?
questions.reference: The proposal gives institutional investors an 18-month window to buy newly built BTR communities.

questions.question: Under the ROAD Act, which investors are banned from buying additional single-family homes, and when does the ban take effect?
questions.reference: The ban applies to investors owning 350 or more single-family homes and takes effect January 7, 2027.

questions.question: What penalty can violations of the ROAD Act's institutional investor ban bring, according to the Treasury BTR article?
questions.reference: Violations could bring civil penalties of up to $1 million or three times the property's purchase price, including land.

questions.question: How much in home equity originations does Deephaven's Tom Davis expect in 2026?
questions.reference: Tom Davis expects home equity originations to reach about $150 billion in 2026.

questions.question: How much home equity does Deephaven's Tom Davis estimate exists as a potential source of lending volume?
questions.reference: Davis estimated that about $35 trillion in home equity exists as a potential source of lending volume.

questions.question: What average recapture rate did Tom Davis estimate for independent mortgage banks?
questions.reference: Davis estimated that recapture rates among independent mortgage banks average 30% to 35%.

questions.question: What does Blue Sage Solutions' Joey McDuffee say more borrowers want to do instead of relocating?
questions.reference: McDuffee said more and more borrowers want to renovate, not relocate.

questions.question: What share of respondents in the 2026 CMA survey said CMAs will become more relevant in the future?
questions.reference: 89.6% of respondents said CMAs will become more relevant in the future, up from 67% in 2020.

questions.question: How many real estate professionals responded to the Giant Steps Advisors and Lone Wolf Technologies 2026 CMA survey?
questions.reference: The survey had 2,165 U.S. real estate professionals respond between November 2025 and February 2026.

questions.question: What did the CMA survey find about agents' willingness to let algorithms handle home pricing?
questions.reference: Agents are embracing AI, but they aren't ready to hand over the business of pricing homes to algorithms.

questions.question: What percentage of CMA survey respondents trust the multiple listing service above other sources for comparable property information?
questions.reference: 90.8% of respondents trust the multiple listing service above other sources.

questions.question: What is the name of the Scottsdale, Arizona brokerage that built an internal AI ecosystem, and who is its broker-owner?
questions.reference: The brokerage is Incyte Realty, led by broker-owner Frank Vazquez.

questions.question: What tasks does Incyte Realty's AI assistant Morgan handle?
questions.reference: Morgan handles front-desk reception, property sign calls, text conversations and appointment scheduling.

questions.question: How did average production per agent at Incyte Realty change, according to the article?
questions.reference: Average production increased from 6.3 transactions per agent to nearly eight.

questions.question: How many leads per week does Incyte Realty's consumer-direct mortgage tool generate for participating lenders?
questions.reference: The tool generates roughly 50 to 60 leads a week for participating lenders.

questions.question: Who was appointed president and CEO of Sotheby's International Realty, and when does the appointment take effect?
questions.reference: Mark McLaughlin was appointed president and CEO of Sotheby's International Realty, effective Nov. 1.

questions.question: What role is Philip White transitioning into at Sotheby's International Realty, and how large did the network grow under him?
questions.reference: Philip White will become executive chairman after helping grow the network to 1,100 offices in 86 countries.

questions.question: How did Sotheby's International Realty become part of the Compass ecosystem?
questions.reference: Compass's acquisition of Sotheby's parent company, Anywhere Real Estate, closed earlier this year, and Sotheby's is continuing its integration into the Compass International Holdings ecosystem.

questions.question: How many mergers and acquisitions did Mark McLaughlin lead while scaling his previous brokerage, and to what sales volume?
questions.reference: McLaughlin led 12 mergers and acquisitions while scaling the brokerage to $14.1 billion in sales volume.

questions.question: Which two government actions affecting housing were reported on October 22, 2026?
questions.reference: President Trump signed a housing executive order covering mortgage insurance, title insurance waivers, manufactured housing and USDA and VA loan rates, and the Treasury issued a proposed rule with exemptions for build-to-rent communities from the ROAD Act's institutional investor ban.

questions.question: What do the articles say about the role of refinances in title insurance versus the home equity market?
questions.reference: KBW analysts note that refinances account for only around 7% of title premiums, while Deephaven's Tom Davis says the cash-out game today is equity, not traditional refis.

questions.question: What do the CMA survey article and the Incyte Realty article say about AI in real estate brokerages?
questions.reference: The CMA survey found 83.2% of agents are likely to use AI-assisted CMA tools but they won't hand pricing over to algorithms, while Incyte Realty uses an AI assistant named Morgan to handle reception and scheduling.

questions.question: What rate-lowering efforts or targets appear in the Trump executive order article and the Logan Mohtashami 10-year yield article?
questions.reference: The executive order directs USDA and VA to reduce interest rates on their single-family home loans, and Mohtashami says the goal is to get mortgage rates back under 6.64% by pushing the 10-year yield lower.

questions.question: How do the Trump executive order and Treasury's BTR proposal each address new or manufactured housing?
questions.reference: The executive order sets up a task force to improve quality and lower the cost of manufactured housing, while Treasury's proposal exempts purpose-built build-to-rent communities bought within 18 months after receiving a certificate of occupancy from the investor ban.
